    Your numbers

    See what the music actually costs you.

    Two bills come with background music in the Netherlands: the service you stream it from, and the BumaStemra license the music itself needs. Sonable's catalogue is AI-generated and not registered with BumaStemra, so the second one is not required for the music you stream through us. Enter the floor area where the music plays and see the difference over a year.

    A separate Sena fee for playing music in your space may still apply, whichever provider you use, so it is not counted as a saving here.

    The BumaStemra figure is an indication, not a quote. Background-music tariffs are charged per 100 m² of publicly accessible floor area and then vary by the kind of business, opening hours and how you register. Check your own figure at mijnlicentie.nl.

    The conventional service figure is the published price range on our comparison page, taken from providers' own public pages, and may change. Sonable's figure is our own list price on monthly billing.

    AI + Human Touch

    Technology creates. Humans perfect.

    AI generates the music, but our team of experienced music directors and sound designers curate, refine, and quality check every playlist before it reaches your speakers.

    We build music for the spaces where sound is part of the experience, not the reason people came. On a stage, in a listening bar, in a room built around a performer, the music itself is the point and you should book the artist. That is work Sonable is not here to replace.

    • Expert Curated Collections

      Our music directors hand select and refine every AI generated playlist to ensure emotional resonance and brand fit.

    • Quality Checked by Ear

      Every track passes through human review before it reaches your venue. No robotic artifacts, no off brand surprises.

    • Culturally Aware Selection

      Our curators understand regional tastes and cultural nuances, ensuring your music feels authentic to your audience.

    Venues

    Built for large spaces where atmosphere does the work.

    Hotels & Resorts

    One property, many moods. Lobby, restaurant, spa and pool each get their own sound, scheduled from a single dashboard.

    Restaurant & Bar Groups

    The same recognisable feel across every site, shifting with the room from lunch service to late evening.

    Retail Floors & Flagships

    Large floors people move through slowly. Sound that makes a space easy to navigate and comfortable to stay in.

    Health & Fitness Clubs

    Studio, gym floor and changing rooms each need their own tempo, and none of them should feel clinical.

    Cafés & Smaller Venues

    Not who we built this for, but the same catalogue works in a single room, and the plan scales down as easily as it scales up.

    Waiting Rooms & Practices

    One small room with one job: making a wait feel shorter. Unobtrusive enough that the staff who hear it all day never ask for it off.

    Why music matters

    Sound shapes how people feel, stay and spend.

    Decades of research, and a fresh wave of 2023 to 2026 studies, show that the right ambient music lowers stress, lengthens dwell time and lifts revenue. The catch: it has to fit the room, not just fill the silence.

    34
    RCTs reviewed (JMIR, 2025)

    Music reduces cortisol, heart rate and blood pressure, beating white noise for stress recovery.

    ~15%
    Higher transaction value

    Field experiment (Verma & Rao, 2024) on culturally matched ambient music plus scent.

    Up to 8%
    Sales uplift

    When playlists match brand identity (commercial background music field trials, 2026).
